measurements.definition: a land tax on each pattern at the rate that balances council tax (VOA private count × band ratio × the authority's Band D) over all homes; the test is 50 × Σ|cell land tax − authority-share land tax| ÷ council tax, over cells nationally and over each seat's cells, in points; seat totals compare 100 × |the seat's difference| ÷ its council tax

measurements.survey_private_sector_rule: the survey's owner-occupier and private-renter means, weighted by the private stock's owner-occupied share in the same cells (Census 2021 TS054), moved to the basis by the UK HPI

social_values.rule: MVS 2024 AT1.3 regional all-social-renters mean, July 2024, moved to the calendar-2024 basis by the region's UK HPI all-dwellings index; Wales: England's social ÷ private-sector mean ratio × its own sales-based private mean

tenure.basis: Census 2021 TS054 by local authority: private-sector stock is all households less social rented; the owner-occupied share is owned outright plus owned with a mortgage over that private stock

msoa_facts_receipt.basis: Census 2021 TS054 by msoa: private-sector stock is all households less social rented; the owner-occupied share is owned outright plus owned with a mortgage over that private stock

tenure.rule: social homes per authority = VOA all properties × Census 2021 TS054 social rented share; spread over its MSOAs by each MSOA's TS054 social share × its count
